Spark NorthWest 3G Shutdown -

## The box and whisker plot is focusing on the customers who had needed to ugrade to froma 3G device to a 4G/5G device, mainly showing the relationship of age of the customer(avergae age since the form was asked a age range, had to find the average fromt that) against the type of device that they had chose to upgrade to. The box and whisker plot also is showing a star, these display the mean age of for example, all the customers who chose to upgrade to Samsung, what was the mean age that did upgrade to Samsung. We can see from the box and whisker plot that the age range of the customers who had chosen to upgrade to MobiWire or HMS which are button phojnes, are more older than the people who chose to upgrade to “smart phones”, which are all the rest of the brands that we see on the graph. From this we can conclude that the elderly customers tend to stick to what they know, fromt he plot we cxcan say around the 70-80 age range, whereas yougner than that 50-70 tend to go with Smart phones, mostly Samsung by the looks of it.

## The bar plot is showing what kind of device the customer upgrade to based on their original device, from this plot we can easily conclude that the people who originally had button phones, most of them (34 out of ), went for HMD or one of the MobiWire phones which are button phones, the people who had Smart phones originally however, most of them went for Samsung, or other smart phone devices like iPhone or Motorola, only 2 out of the bunch had chose to get button phones. This shows us that the people who originalyl had button phgones, preferred to stay with button phones, the people who originally had smart phones preferred to stay with smart phones.

## The dot plot is showing when the survey was done by the agents of the store, mostly were done after work and not during work, this is mosdt probably because of how busy we were during the period of the 3G shutdown! The darker colours of the dots represent when the most responses for the form was done (the lighter the colour of the dot means not many survyes was done, darker meaning many surveys was done), this can be seen done on Sundays a lot, with Sunday showing thte ost surveys done around 8PM. The size of the dot also indicates how many surveys was done on the day, bigger size indicates a lot of surveys were done, smaller size indicates not many surveys were done. Both on the side of the graph is shown the gradient of the colour indicating how many surveys were done as well as the size showing how many surveys were done.

The final 2 bar grpahs show how our customers were feeling when upgrading their device from 3G to 4G/5G device, most of the customers who were upgrading from a smart phone were nervous as well as a lot of responses being excited about the new changes, some were frustrated, that is underdstandable as more they probably have spent quite a biut of money upgrading to a new device. The other bar plot on the other hand, the people who were upfgrading from a button phone, we can confidently say most of the customers were nervous about sdwitching to a device. This is understandable as they are probably not familiar with technology and was very nervous and uncomfortable about making the switch to a new device. Our elderly customers tend to stick to what they know, so switching to something new may most definitely make them nervous about the whole switch.
